name: scan
description: Scan Python packages for structural smells. Returns the JSON report: per-package grade and score, every finding with file, line, severity, rule, message and fingerprint.

packages.description: Packages to scan as {name: path}; omitted, the project's [tool.spaghetti] registry or auto-discovery applies

name: plan
description: Prioritised remediation plan: rules ranked by severity × fix effort (× git churn with hotspots=true), each with its affected files, a fix pattern and the full finding list. Start here to decide what to fix first.

hotspots.description: Weight by git change frequency (needs a git checkout)

name: explain_rule
description: What a rule catches, why it matters, the refactoring that fixes it, its thresholds and the Pylint/Ruff/SonarQube equivalents.

name: compare
description: Delta against a stored snapshot: score change, findings introduced and fixed, files that got worse. ref is 'latest', '~N', a git SHA prefix or a timestamp prefix.

name: baseline
description: Baseline management. action='status' reports how many findings the baseline hides and which it lists as fixed; action='update' rewrites it from the current scan so only new findings fail CI from now on.
